description: Pfam clan membership, Gtt3-family domain co-occurrence, and the complete GO annotation state of P39996
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, numpy as np
plt.rcParams.update({'font.size':9,'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(14,4.4),gridspec_kw={'wspace':0.45,'width_ratios':[1.05,1.0,1.1]})

# A. Pfam clan membership
ax=axes[0]
rows=[('GTT3_N (PF27945)','none','#E45756'),('GTT3_C (PF30540)','none','#E45756'),
      ('GST_N (PF02798)','CL0172 Thioredoxin','#54A24B'),('GST_N_2 (PF13409)','CL0172 Thioredoxin','#54A24B'),
      ('Glutaredoxin (PF00462)','CL0172 Thioredoxin','#54A24B'),
      ('GST_C (PF00043)','CL0497 GST_C','#88D27A'),('GST_C_2 (PF13410)','CL0497 GST_C','#88D27A')]
for i,(fam,clan,c) in enumerate(rows):
    ax.barh(i,1,color=c)
    ax.text(0.03,i,fam,va='center',fontsize=8,color='w')
    ax.text(1.05,i,clan,va='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,2.6); ax.invert_yaxis()
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('A. Pfam clan membership.\n    The Gtt3 families join no clan, so Pfam profile-profile\n    comparison does not link them to the thioredoxin or\n    GST_C superfamilies',loc='left',fontsize=9)

# B. co-occurring domains in the Gtt3 family
ax=axes[1]
d=pd.read_csv('out/gtt3_family_cooccurring_domains.csv')
d=d[d.interpro!='IPR038872']
lab=[f"{n}\n({a})" for a,n in zip(d.interpro,d.name)]
lab=[l.replace('Glutathione transferase 3, ','Gtt3 ') for l in lab]
cols=['#9ECAE9','#4C78A8','#9ECAE9','#4C78A8']
ax.bar(range(len(d)),d.pct,color=['#4C78A8' if 'SAP' in n or 'Rho' in n else '#9ECAE9' for n in d.name])
ax.set_xticks(range(len(d))); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=7,rotation=20,ha='right')
ax.set_ylabel('% of 70 sampled family members')
ax.set_ylim(0,75)
for i,v in enumerate(d.pct): ax.text(i,v+1.5,f'{v}%',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_title('B. Domains found on members of the fungal Gtt3 family\n    (IPR038872, 1395 UniProt proteins, 70 sampled).\n    No GST_N, GST_C, thioredoxin or glutaredoxin in any member',loc='left',fontsize=9)

# C. GO annotation state
ax=axes[2]
go=[('GO:0003674 molecular_function','MF','ND / ECO:0000307','#E45756'),
    ('GO:0008150 biological_process','BP','ND / ECO:0000307','#E45756'),
    ('GO:0016020 membrane','CC','IBA / ECO:0000318','#54A24B'),
    ('GO:0031965 nuclear membrane','CC','IEA / ECO:0007322','#88D27A'),
    ('GO:0034399 nuclear periphery','CC','HDA / PMID 26928762','#54A24B')]
for i,(t,asp,ev,c) in enumerate(go):
    ax.barh(i,1,color=c); ax.text(0.03,i,t,va='center',fontsize=8,color='w')
    ax.text(1.05,i,ev,va='center',fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks([]); ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_xlim(0,2.9); ax.invert_yaxis()
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.set_title('C. Every GO annotation on P39996 (QuickGO, 5 total).\n    MF and BP are "no biological data available";\n    no glutathione transferase term exists to remove',loc='left',fontsize=9)
fig.suptitle('Gtt3 family-level and annotation-level evidence: a fungal SAP/HeH plus transmembrane family wrongly named after glutathione transferase',
             fontsize=11,y=1.03)
plt.show()
